releaseTitle: Time Clock and Schedule Roster Role Runtime Repair
notes: Repairs the remaining production Time Clock and Schedule crash by preventing rosterRoleIdentityCore.cjs from being treated as a static media URL by CRA/Webpack.
Preserves the same roster-role identity implementation for browser, API, schedule publishing, and Node tests through a shared JavaScript source plus CommonJS proxy.
Extends the production-bundle contract so schedule runtime certification fails if rosterRoleIdentityCore is ever emitted as .cjs media again.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.28
summary: Repairs the remaining production-only Time Clock and Schedule crash caused by rosterRoleIdentityCore.cjs being emitted as a static media URL.
